description:
`gf2_sim::snr_checkpoint::config_hash` does not cover the code rate, modulation, decoder or demapper, so `--resume` with a different decoder reuses checkpoints of another configuration and reports their results as its own.

## Background

Reproduced while writing the coded-modulation link simulation tutorial.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Two configurations differing in rate, modulation, decoder or demapper have different checkpoint identities, covered by a test for each field.
- [hard] REQ-02: Resuming with a configuration whose identity differs from the checkpoint's reuses no checkpointed point, covered by a test.
- [hard] REQ-03: A fixed seed and configuration produce identical results with and without resume.
title: SNR checkpoint config hash omits rate, modulation, decoder and demapper
